Reconstruct explicitly matched two-view fish trajectories into 3D

Source: R/camera-rig.R
aqt_reconstruct_3d.Rd

This is a strict known-correspondence stereo primitive. The external correspondences table must supply correctly matched fish identities and original timestamps in two already synchronized camera clocks. A track ID in one camera is NOT assumed to match the same ID in another. Water/glass/air refraction and fisheye effects must be corrected with separately validated calibration models; this function will reject a rig declaring a refractive optical interface.

Usage

aqt_reconstruct_3d(view_a, view_b, correspondences, rig, max_skew_s = 0.02)

Arguments

view_a, view_b

2D image-pixel aqt_tracks, each from one camera.

correspondences

Data frame session_id, id_a, id_b, time_a_s, time_b_s, fish_id. Each row describes one known matching pair.

rig

aqt_rig containing both cameras' P matrices.

max_skew_s

Maximum permitted absolute synchronized time difference.

Value

A physical-unit 3D aqt_tracks object with reprojection and time-skew diagnostics and source track labels.
